messages:
Priya: quick follow-up from today's infra update : When a region sees a fast capacity drop, what's the immediate user-visible flow? queue, spill, degrade? cc @Alex

Alex (Infrastructure): short answer: try to absorb locally + short queue, then soft-spill to nearest-region if latency budget allows, then model-variant degrade (quantized/smaller), lastly 503+Retry-After. we'll publish a one-pager with thresholds.

Priya: teams want the numeric cutoffs (queue p95, region capacity %) and an ETA for the playbook.

Jamie (SRE): from the latest canary: queue.p95 > 420ms was the tipping point and we spilled APAC -> EU. snippet from the canary logs:

```
2026-03-24T02:11:07Z spot: reclaim 38% nodepool
2026-03-24T02:11:08Z queue.p95 428ms -> spill->eu-west1
2026-03-24T02:11:09Z routing: retry -> eu-west1
```

Ops Bot: Canary run complete: canary-243210-03-24 -> success. Report: https://redwood.internal/canaries/2432101111 :eyes:

Ruth (Product): product requests a per-project opt-out toggle for cross-region spill (residency), and ideally an estimated latency penalty shown in the console before teams enable it.

Alex (Infrastructure): agreed. plan: backend + audit events next sprint, UI toggle sprint+1. Playbook draft will include: spill if region capacity < 12% OR queue.p95 > 400ms; degrade only if spill blocked OR cross-region latency > 150ms. Posting draft Monday morning.

Priya: any oncall implications? we need a short checklist.

Jamie (SRE): will put a 1-page runbook in #eng-oncall: 1) check region capacity, 2) check spill flag, 3) inspect spill.telemetry (reason, dest_region), 4) rollback guidance. Also adding alert: spill.rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m.

Priya: good. regarding quality, product teams are worried quantized fallback changes outputs. can we automate diffs?

Ruth (Product): ask teams to submit 3 representative prompt suites. we'll run an automated diff against quantized variants and report a quality delta score in Optimize.

Alex (Infrastructure): action items: Alex draft playbook + publish, Jamie add telemetry & alerts, Ruth collect prompt suites + quality pipeline, Ops Bot schedule follow-up sync.

Ops Bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: "Region Fallback Playbook sync" Tue 10:00 PT. Invite sent.

Priya: thanks everyone for the quick answers. :thumbsup:
